_comment: flywheel factory event log. OPT-IN: pg-log.sh exits immediately unless ~/.local/state/pg-factory/ exists, so installing this plugin changes nothing until you run `mkdir -p ~/.local/state/pg-factory`. Verified live on both harnesses 2026-09-01, not read off the docs: (1) the plugin-root reference MUST be double-quoted -- Claude Code passes the command to a shell and relies on it to expand $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, so single quotes kill every hook with 'cannot open ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/...', while Droid substitutes textually and works either way; (2) PostToolUse carries NO matcher -- omitting it matches every tool on both, a `matcher: "*"` entry logged nothing on Claude Code, and registering both forms made Droid fire twice per call; and (3) Droid IGNORES hook events it does not know, so the last five keys here are Claude-only and cost Droid nothing. SubagentStart is the one that matters: without it a subagent's clock starts at its first tool call, which undercounted a measured 7-second subagent as 3 seconds and made a zero-tool subagent invisible. async:true is honoured by Claude Code and ignored by Droid, which runs the hook synchronously at ~9ms.
